name: Concurso de Saltos Nacional - B + Provas de Escolas
venue: Centro Hípico do Porto e Matosinhos
description: This event is a national show jumping competition, including school trials. It takes place at the Centro Hípico do Porto e Matosinhos.
longDescription:
The Concurso de Saltos Nacional - B + Provas de Escolas is a national show jumping competition. The event also features school trials, indicating participation from various levels of riders. It is scheduled to run for three days.

The competition will be held from October 30, 2026, starting at 09:00, until November 1, 2026, concluding at 18:00. The venue for this equestrian event is the Centro Hípico do Porto e Matosinhos, located in Matosinhos.
